name: seaway
description: Work with seaway, a framework for Archil: compose the context an agent needs, then run statements that say what they touch, explain themselves before they run, and are priced. Skills for both SDKs, review and porting agents, a linter, and an MCP server that opens a context as tools.

sdk_path.title: seaway checkout
sdk_path.description: A checkout of the seaway repository, for the MCP server to load the SDK from. Leave empty when Claude Code runs inside a checkout, or in a project that installed seaway.

manifest.title: Context manifest
manifest.description: A context manifest for the MCP server to open on first use, as a path relative to the project. Leave empty to open contexts with the open_context tool.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Where the MCP server opens contexts when a call does not say. "local" keeps everything on this machine; "archil" is the live account, and bills.

max_usd.title: Session budget (USD)
max_usd.description: The most one MCP session may spend, by the plans' estimates. A statement that would pass it is refused before it runs. "none" lifts the ceiling.

confirm_live_runs.title: Ask before live runs
confirm_live_runs.description: Ask before Claude acts on the live Archil account: before a command that passes --archil, and before the MCP server opens a context there. Such a run bills per call and can create disks.

lint_on_edit.title: Lint on edit
lint_on_edit.description: After an edit to a file that imports seaway, tell Claude what seaway-lint found in it.
